sunday november 8th 11 a.m. molly harkin 1st anniversary + her late husband francie & her daughter nuala. the october quiz held in honour of the late john gallagher raised €2355 which will go a long way on furnishing a new kitchen for the preparation of meals for the 2 parish primary schools and the creche in glen- finn. annjie gallagher and the gallagher family wish to thank people who attended and also donors who supported either by sponsoring prizes or by giving donations. there won’t be any quiz in november as a mark of respect on john gallagher’s death. paróiste chill taobhóige tithe pobail ghleann fhinne agus leitir bric all saints day - sunday year a — november 1st 2026 thoughts on the gospel for all saints day november 1st 2026 today the church commemorates all those persons who lived in friendship with god on their earthly journey and entered through it into his glory. some saints are raised to the altars as models of virtue and love for god. but many others left an im- print of sanctity day after day that perhaps passed unnoticed to human eyes, but that never escaped the attentive and loving eyes of god. as monsignor fernando ocáriz, prelate of opus dei, said: “all saints day is the feast of that quiet and simple sanctity —sanctity without any human splendor —which seems to leave no trace in history, but shines forth before god. it leaves behind in the world a sowing of love from which nothing is lost.”for the gospel of today’s mass, the liturgy chose the passage of the beatitudes according to saint matthew. thus it underlines the fact that these are the equivalent of sanctity, both of the sanctity that makes some peo-ple famous, so to speak, and the sanctity that is only fully revealed in heaven. november novena for the dead it will begin on saturday 31st october with the lighting of the memorial candles at 6 p.m. mass. and conclude at 7 p.m. mass on thursday november 12th. envelopes for the november lists are available in both chapels. please draws in the hall and that will include 10 lambs(the biggest number we ever had), fuel vouchers, cash prizes 4 bikes etc and of course a huge 55” smart tv (sharp brand) thank you. please come out and sup- port our efforts . anyone who would like to support the bazaar and cannot attend it, might like to drop a donation into the special boxes that will be in the chapels for the next week or so. the indulgence is then only partial – but still of great benefit to our beloved deceased. fr philip kemmy, ppfr. damien nejad, cc office address : parochial house, main street, newtowncunningham
